Seven judicial officers of the Delhi district courts on Monday (September 21, 2026) took oath as judges of the Delhi High Court, increasing the court’s strength to 50.

Chief Justice D.K. Upadhyaya administered the oath to Justices Nivedita Anil Sharma, Nisha Sahay Saxena, Sanjay Sharma, Bharat Parashar, Aditi Choudhary, Dinesh Bhatt, and Arun Bhardwaj at a ceremony held on the High Court premises.
The seven judges have been appointed following a recommendation by the Supreme Court collegium. The Centre notified their appointments on September 19.
Justices Nivedita Anil Sharma and Nisha Sahay Saxena took the oath in English, while the remaining five judges took their oath in Hindi.
The Chief Justice congratulated the newly appointed judges after administering the oath.
With their appointment, the High Court’s strength has risen to 50 against a sanctioned strength of 60, leaving 10 vacancies.
